column1: 炸弹·爆破
column2: Bombs · Demolition

column1: 炸弹提高携带者的护甲穿透。每个战场开打后不久，一发导弹落到战场中心，轰炸并击飞所有敌方单位。
column2: Bombs grant their carriers Armor Pen. Shortly after each battlefield begins, a missile strikes the center of the field, blasting and knocking up every enemy unit.

column1: 每件炸弹为携带者提供 +5 护甲穿透 · 【导弹轰炸】每个战场开打第 {C:BombSynergySystem.FIRE_AT} 秒，导弹落到战场中心，对所有敌方单位造成 {C:BombSynergySystem.DMG_FLAT[0]} + 目标最大生命值 {C:BombSynergySystem.DMG_MAXHP[0]%}% 的物理伤害，并击飞 {C:BombSynergySystem.AIR_SEC} 秒，龟蛋除外
column2: Each Bomb item grants its carrier +5 Armor Pen · [Missile Strike] {C:BombSynergySystem.FIRE_AT} seconds into each battlefield, a missile strikes the center of the field, dealing {C:BombSynergySystem.DMG_FLAT[0]} + {C:BombSynergySystem.DMG_MAXHP[0]%}% of the target's max health as physical damage to every enemy unit and knocking them up for {C:BombSynergySystem.AIR_SEC} second (eggs excluded)

column1: 每件炸弹为携带者提供 +12 护甲穿透 · 【导弹轰炸】伤害提高至 {C:BombSynergySystem.DMG_FLAT[1]} + 目标最大生命值 {C:BombSynergySystem.DMG_MAXHP[1]%}%
column2: Each Bomb item grants its carrier +12 Armor Pen · [Missile Strike] damage increased to {C:BombSynergySystem.DMG_FLAT[1]} + {C:BombSynergySystem.DMG_MAXHP[1]%}% of the target's max health

column1: 每件炸弹为携带者提供 +20 护甲穿透 · 【导弹轰炸】伤害提高至 {C:BombSynergySystem.DMG_FLAT[2]} + 目标最大生命值 {C:BombSynergySystem.DMG_MAXHP[2]%}%
column2: Each Bomb item grants its carrier +20 Armor Pen · [Missile Strike] damage increased to {C:BombSynergySystem.DMG_FLAT[2]} + {C:BombSynergySystem.DMG_MAXHP[2]%}% of the target's max health

column1: 鞭炮
column2: Firecrackers

column1: 普攻有几率在目标周围炸开一串鞭炮，造成范围物理伤害。
column2: Attacks have a chance to set off a string of firecrackers around the target, dealing area physical damage.

column1: 普攻有 {C:EqBombBatch.CRACKER_CHANCE%}% 几率在目标周围炸开一串鞭炮，对 {C:EqBombBatch.CRACKER_R} 码内的敌人造成 {C:EqBombBatch.CRACKER_ATK%}% 攻击力的物理伤害。
column2: Attacks have a {C:EqBombBatch.CRACKER_CHANCE%}% chance to set off a string of firecrackers around the target, dealing {C:EqBombBatch.CRACKER_ATK%}% Attack as physical damage to enemies within {C:EqBombBatch.CRACKER_R} units.

column1: 爆竹筒
column2: Firework Tube

column1: 定时在自己周围炸一圈，击退身边的敌人并获得护盾。
column2: Periodically bursts around itself, knocking back nearby enemies and gaining a shield.

column1: 每 {C:EqBombBatch.TUBE_IV} 秒在自己周围炸一圈：击退 {C:EqBombBatch.TUBE_R} 码内的敌人，造成（{C:EqBombBatch.TUBE_FLAT}+{C:EqBombBatch.TUBE_ATK%}% 攻击力）物理伤害，并获得 {C:EqBombBatch.TUBE_SHIELD} 点护盾，持续 {C:EqBombBatch.TUBE_SHIELD_SEC} 秒。
column2: Every {C:EqBombBatch.TUBE_IV} seconds, bursts around itself: knocks back enemies within {C:EqBombBatch.TUBE_R} units, dealing ({C:EqBombBatch.TUBE_FLAT} + {C:EqBombBatch.TUBE_ATK%}% Attack) physical damage, and gains a {C:EqBombBatch.TUBE_SHIELD} shield for {C:EqBombBatch.TUBE_SHIELD_SEC} seconds.

column1: 手雷
column2: Grenade

column1: 定时朝敌人最密集处扔手雷，造成范围物理伤害并破甲。
column2: Periodically throws a grenade at the densest group of enemies, dealing area physical damage and shredding armor.

column1: 每 {C:EqBombBatch.GRENADE_IV} 秒朝敌人最密集处扔一颗手雷，对 {C:EqBombBatch.GRENADE_R} 码内的敌人造成（{C:EqBombBatch.GRENADE_FLAT}+{C:EqBombBatch.GRENADE_ATK%}% 攻击力）物理伤害，并使其护甲降低 {C:EqBombBatch.GRENADE_SHRED}，持续 {C:EqBombBatch.GRENADE_SHRED_SEC} 秒。
column2: Every {C:EqBombBatch.GRENADE_IV} seconds, throws a grenade at the densest group of enemies, dealing ({C:EqBombBatch.GRENADE_FLAT} + {C:EqBombBatch.GRENADE_ATK%}% Attack) physical damage to enemies within {C:EqBombBatch.GRENADE_R} units and reducing their Armor by {C:EqBombBatch.GRENADE_SHRED} for {C:EqBombBatch.GRENADE_SHRED_SEC} seconds.

column1: 烟雾弹
column2: Smoke Bomb

column1: 定时放烟雾，烟里的友军获得潜行，潜行中的攻击额外造成真实伤害。
column2: Periodically releases smoke. Allies in the smoke gain stealth, and attacks from stealth deal bonus true damage.

column1: 每 {C:EqBombBatch.SMOKE_IV} 秒在身边放一团烟雾，持续 {C:EqBombBatch.SMOKE_SEC} 秒。烟雾内的友军每 {C:EqBombBatch.SMOKE_PULSE} 秒获得一次潜行：无法被选中，攻击时现形。潜行状态下的下一次攻击额外造成（{C:EqBombBatch.SMOKE_TRUE_FLAT}+{C:EqBombBatch.SMOKE_TRUE_ATK%}% 攻击力）真实伤害。
column2: Every {C:EqBombBatch.SMOKE_IV} seconds, releases a cloud of smoke around itself for {C:EqBombBatch.SMOKE_SEC} seconds. Allies inside gain stealth every {C:EqBombBatch.SMOKE_PULSE} second: they can't be targeted and are revealed when they attack. The next attack from stealth deals ({C:EqBombBatch.SMOKE_TRUE_FLAT} + {C:EqBombBatch.SMOKE_TRUE_ATK%}% Attack) bonus true damage.

column1: 粘弹
column2: Sticky Bomb

column1: 定时丢粘弹减速敌人，爆炸后铺粘液，叠加中毒。
column2: Periodically throws a sticky bomb that slows an enemy, then explodes into a pool of goo that stacks Poison.

column1: 每 {C:EqBombBatch.STICKY_IV} 秒朝一个敌人丢一枚粘弹，使其移动速度降低 {C:EqBombBatch.STICKY_SLOW%}%，持续 {C:EqBombBatch.STICKY_FUSE} 秒；随后粘弹爆炸，造成（{C:EqBombBatch.STICKY_FLAT}+{C:EqBombBatch.STICKY_ATK%}% 攻击力）物理伤害，并在地上铺粘液 {C:EqBombBatch.GOO_SEC} 秒：粘液里的敌人移动速度降低 {C:EqBombBatch.GOO_SLOW%}%，每 {C:EqBombBatch.GOO_TICK} 秒叠加 {C:EqBombBatch.GOO_POISON} 层中毒。
column2: Every {C:EqBombBatch.STICKY_IV} seconds, throws a sticky bomb at an enemy, slowing its move speed by {C:EqBombBatch.STICKY_SLOW%}% for {C:EqBombBatch.STICKY_FUSE} seconds. The bomb then explodes, dealing ({C:EqBombBatch.STICKY_FLAT} + {C:EqBombBatch.STICKY_ATK%}% Attack) physical damage and leaving goo on the ground for {C:EqBombBatch.GOO_SEC} seconds: enemies in the goo are slowed by {C:EqBombBatch.GOO_SLOW%}% and gain {C:EqBombBatch.GOO_POISON} Poison stacks every {C:EqBombBatch.GOO_TICK} seconds.

column1: 地雷
column2: Landmine

column1: 在站位图里摆地雷，敌人踩中爆炸并眩晕。
column2: Place landmines on the formation map. Enemies that step on them are blasted and stunned.

column1: 在站位图中摆放 {C:EqBombBatch.MINE_COUNT} 颗地雷（不摆则埋在己方前排正前方，对手看不见）。敌人踩中时爆炸，对 {C:EqBombBatch.MINE_BLAST_R} 码内的敌人造成 {C:EqBombBatch.MINE_DMG} 物理伤害并眩晕 {C:EqBombBatch.MINE_STUN} 秒。
column2: Place {C:EqBombBatch.MINE_COUNT} landmines on the formation map (if not placed, they are buried in front of your front line; invisible to the opponent). When an enemy steps on one, it explodes, dealing {C:EqBombBatch.MINE_DMG} physical damage to enemies within {C:EqBombBatch.MINE_BLAST_R} units and stunning them for {C:EqBombBatch.MINE_STUN} seconds.

column1: 炸药桶
column2: Powder Keg

column1: 阵亡时原地大爆炸，按自身最大生命值造成范围物理伤害。
column2: Explodes on death, dealing area physical damage based on its own max health.

column1: 阵亡时原地大爆炸，对 {C:EqBombBatch.BARREL_R} 码内的敌人造成自身最大生命值 {C:EqBombBatch.BARREL_PCT%}% 的物理伤害。
column2: On death, explodes where it stands, dealing physical damage equal to {C:EqBombBatch.BARREL_PCT%}% of its own max health to enemies within {C:EqBombBatch.BARREL_R} units.

column1: 定时炸弹
column2: Time Bomb

column1: 定时给敌人绑炸弹，每绑一颗之后的伤害都更高。
column2: Periodically straps a bomb to an enemy. Each bomb strapped makes later ones deal more damage.

column1: 每 {C:EqBombBatch.TIMER_IV} 秒给最近的敌人绑一颗定时炸弹，{C:EqBombBatch.TIMER_FUSE} 秒后爆炸，对 {C:EqBombBatch.TIMER_R} 码内的敌人造成（{C:EqBombBatch.TIMER_FLAT}+{C:EqBombBatch.TIMER_ATK%}% 攻击力）物理伤害。每绑一颗，之后的定时炸弹伤害提高 {C:EqBombBatch.TIMER_STACK%}%，跨战场保留，一局结束重置。
column2: Every {C:EqBombBatch.TIMER_IV} seconds, straps a time bomb to the nearest enemy. After {C:EqBombBatch.TIMER_FUSE} seconds it explodes, dealing ({C:EqBombBatch.TIMER_FLAT} + {C:EqBombBatch.TIMER_ATK%}% Attack) physical damage to enemies within {C:EqBombBatch.TIMER_R} units. Each bomb strapped increases the damage of later time bombs by {C:EqBombBatch.TIMER_STACK%}%. Carries over between battlefields and resets when the match ends.

column1: 炮筒
column2: Cannon

column1: 召唤一门高血量炮筒，龟能满时进入重炮状态，直线击退并流血。
column2: Summons a sturdy cannon. At full Energy it switches to heavy shells that fly in a line, knocking back and applying Bleed.

column1: 登场时在己方后方召唤一门炮筒：{C:EqBombBatch.CANNON_HP} 生命值、{C:EqBombBatch.CANNON_ATK} 攻击力，龟能上限 {C:EqBombBatch.CANNON_EN_MAX}。炮筒每 {C:EqBombBatch.CANNON_IV} 秒朝敌人开一炮，造成 100% 攻击力的物理伤害，每炮获得 {C:EqBombBatch.CANNON_EN_GAIN} 龟能。龟能满时进入重炮状态：每发消耗 {C:EqBombBatch.CANNON_HEAVY_COST} 龟能，炮弹沿直线飞行，击退直线上的敌人，造成 {C:EqBombBatch.CANNON_HEAVY_MULT%}% 攻击力的物理伤害并施加 {C:EqBombBatch.CANNON_HEAVY_BLEED} 层流血；龟能耗尽时回到普通炮击。
column2: On spawn, summons a cannon behind your line: {C:EqBombBatch.CANNON_HP} health, {C:EqBombBatch.CANNON_ATK} Attack, {C:EqBombBatch.CANNON_EN_MAX} max Energy. Every {C:EqBombBatch.CANNON_IV} seconds the cannon fires at an enemy, dealing 100% Attack as physical damage and gaining {C:EqBombBatch.CANNON_EN_GAIN} Energy per shot. At full Energy it switches to heavy shells: each costs {C:EqBombBatch.CANNON_HEAVY_COST} Energy and flies in a straight line, knocking back enemies in its path, dealing {C:EqBombBatch.CANNON_HEAVY_MULT%}% Attack as physical damage and applying {C:EqBombBatch.CANNON_HEAVY_BLEED} Bleed stacks. When Energy runs out, it returns to normal shots.

column1: 遥控炸弹
column2: Remote Bomb

column1: 召唤一枚追着敌人跑的遥控炸弹，生命耗尽时大范围爆炸。
column2: Summons a remote bomb that chases enemies and explodes over a wide area when its health runs out.

column1: 登场时在己方前排召唤一枚遥控炸弹：{C:EqBombBatch.REMOTE_HP} 生命值、{C:EqBombBatch.REMOTE_RES} 护甲和魔抗。它追着一个敌人移动，不攻击，每秒损失 {C:EqBombBatch.REMOTE_DECAY%}% 最大生命值。生命值耗尽时爆炸，对 {C:EqBombBatch.REMOTE_R} 码内的敌人造成 {C:EqBombBatch.REMOTE_FLAT} 物理伤害和携带者最大生命值 {C:EqBombBatch.REMOTE_TRUE_PCT%}% 的真实伤害，并施加 {C:EqBombBatch.REMOTE_BLEED} 层流血。
column2: On spawn, summons a remote bomb at your front line: {C:EqBombBatch.REMOTE_HP} health, {C:EqBombBatch.REMOTE_RES} Armor and Magic Resist. It chases an enemy without attacking and loses {C:EqBombBatch.REMOTE_DECAY%}% of its max health per second. When its health runs out, it explodes, dealing {C:EqBombBatch.REMOTE_FLAT} physical damage plus true damage equal to {C:EqBombBatch.REMOTE_TRUE_PCT%}% of the carrier's max health to enemies within {C:EqBombBatch.REMOTE_R} units, and applying {C:EqBombBatch.REMOTE_BLEED} Bleed stacks.

column1: 武士刀
column2: Katana

column1: 召唤一名武士刀小将，前三次技能挥剑气波，第四次蓄力回血后吹出龙卷风。
column2: Summons a Katana Minion. Its first three abilities fire sword waves; the fourth charges up, heals, then unleashes tornadoes.

column1: 登场时召唤一名武士刀小将：{C:EqBombBatch.KATANA_HP} 生命值、{C:EqBombBatch.KATANA_ATK} 攻击力，龟能上限 {C:EqBombBatch.KATANA_EN_MAX}，普攻造成 100% 攻击力的物理伤害。龟能满时释放技能，四次一循环：前三次向前方 {C:EqBombBatch.KATANA_WAVE_LEN} 码挥出一道剑气波，造成 {C:EqBombBatch.KATANA_WAVE_MULT%}% 攻击力的物理伤害；第四次蓄力 {C:EqBombBatch.KATANA_CHARGE} 秒并回复 {C:EqBombBatch.KATANA_HEAL_TOTAL%}% 最大生命值，随后向前方吹出 {C:EqBombBatch.KATANA_TORNADOES} 道龙卷风，造成 {C:EqBombBatch.KATANA_TORNADO_MULT%}% 攻击力的物理伤害并击飞 {C:EqBombBatch.KATANA_AIR} 秒。
column2: On spawn, summons a Katana Minion: {C:EqBombBatch.KATANA_HP} health, {C:EqBombBatch.KATANA_ATK} Attack, {C:EqBombBatch.KATANA_EN_MAX} max Energy; its attacks deal 100% Attack as physical damage. At full Energy it casts an ability in a cycle of four: the first three fire a sword wave {C:EqBombBatch.KATANA_WAVE_LEN} units forward, dealing {C:EqBombBatch.KATANA_WAVE_MULT%}% Attack as physical damage; the fourth charges for {C:EqBombBatch.KATANA_CHARGE} seconds, restoring {C:EqBombBatch.KATANA_HEAL_TOTAL%}% max health, then sends {C:EqBombBatch.KATANA_TORNADOES} tornadoes forward, dealing {C:EqBombBatch.KATANA_TORNADO_MULT%}% Attack as physical damage and knocking up for {C:EqBombBatch.KATANA_AIR} second.
